title: NFR shared definitions
$comment: Definitions shared by the ZTAX-NFR-001 schemas in this directory (ServiceCriticality, SLI, SLO, CapacityProfile, ResilienceProfile). Instances live on the INFRA train under infra/nfr/ (ADR-0015 §2.10) and are validated, cross-referenced and turned into alert rules by infra/tools/nfr.py.

identifier.description: A stable identifier, never reused: an SLO report from last year still names it.

owner.description: The accountable team. An unowned objective is one nobody answers for when it burns.

serviceClass.description: ZTAX-NFR-001 §3 service criticality class. C0 synchronous fiscal; C1 authoritative durable async; C2 operational support; C3 AI/advisory; C4 development/analytics.

duration.description: A duration: integer and unit (ms, s, m, h, d).

status.description: proposed: written, not yet backed by measurement or approval. approved: signed off against measured evidence.

failureBehavior.description: ZTAX-NFR-001 §11. fail_closed: the operation refuses rather than proceeds without the dependency. last_known_good: continues on bounded cached approved state. queue: durable local state, propagation delayed. degrade: the feature degrades, the fiscal core does not. none: not a dependency of this path.
